M5 — 2026-09-16
Schema regen order in rust-core: `npm run build` FIRST, then `npm run schema:emit`, then `cargo xtask schema` (or `npm run schema:check`). emit-fingerprint.mjs reads packages/engine/dist/schema.js, so with a stale dist it silently rewrites packages/schema/schema-fingerprint.txt to the OLD fingerprint — and the Rust snapshot version (snapshot.rs include_str of that file) then disagrees with the TypeScript engine's. Diagnose with `git diff packages/schema/schema-fingerprint.txt` after a merge that touched packages/schema/src.
